title: UnitDestroyed
description: A unit is lost (CONTRACTS §6; STATE-MACHINES §4.1 Destroyed). First producer: an aircraft out of fuel crashes, killer null and no assists (NX-368). Public view: a hidden killer becomes null (FOW-3); a hidden victim is dropped.

killer_id.description: null: no killer (fuel exhaustion), or a hidden killer in the public view.

assist_ids.description: No duplicates (producer). Not uniqueItems: that generates a set, whose order is not deterministic (SC-14).
